concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-account-balances]] — 2026-09-15 snapshot of a 2021-modified Adyen balance-definition guide: pending, next payout, reserve and conditional negative refund allowance form available funds, while Adyen-held deposit is separate.
warnings: The page does not state role or currency aggregation rules; the company-level sum and next-payout amount do not prove bank receipt.
